# opalstack_osuser (Data Source)

Looks up a shell user by `id` or by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_osuser" "deploy" {
  name = "deploy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the shell user.
- `name` (String) Name of the shell user.

### Read-Only

- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the shell user lives on.
